title: Decision-model bake-off run
description: What one provider path returned for a set of bake-off cases (REQ-BEN-005, DEC-2026-10-20 D9, decision-model scope update). Two paths are compared: the LLM path and `decide()` backed by the OpenAI Decisions API. The run calls the model service only through `harness.decide()` or `harness.generate()`. A path that could not run is recorded as NOT_RUN with its reason ('no access: no API key'); nothing is faked, and a NOT_RUN run carries no result. `confidence` is the probability of the selected answer for `decide()` and the model's self-reported confidence for the LLM path; it is information, never authority. Model versions are pinned (PERD §19.1); a result with `model.version` null is allowed only to record that a snapshot could not be pinned. Synthetic inputs only (PERD R-18). SYNTHETIC (AGENT-25).

provider.description: The two paths compared (decision-model scope update): the LLM path and decide() backed by OpenAI Decisions.

runner_region.description: Where the runner executed, for example af-lagos or unknown. Latency is only a Lagos-region measurement when this says so (build prompt T4 item 9a).

cases_version.description: SHA-256 of the case set the run answered, so a result cannot be matched to a different set.

variant.description: BASE, or P<n> for the n-th perturbation of the case (P0 is the first).
